test_title: PYST 18: SSC CHSL 2023 - English (Held On: 08 Aug, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Direction: Parts of a sentence are given below in jumbled order. Arrange the parts in the correct order to form a meaningful sentence.**

(P) and the impact of their

(Q) the authors' journey of self-discovery

(R) the memoir explores

(S) upbringing on their identity
solution:
The correct answer is **"RQPS."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The sentence talks about a memoir exploring the impact of the authors' upbringing on their identity and journey of self-discovery.
 
• Part R has the **structure, subject + verb**, so it must be the first part.
 
• Part Q provides an object to the first part of the sentence, so it must follow R.
 
• The rest of the sentence is the object that is present in the pair PS. So the last pair must be PS.
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.

**Correct sentence**: *The memoir explores (R), the authors' journey of self-discovery and the impact of their (Q), upbringing on their identity (P), and (S) is missing from the given options.*
